description: Before fetching a website, get its known access posture, bot challenge, JavaScript requirement, observed rate limit and machine interface, plus a derived fetch strategy. Returns crowd observations, not instructions. Responses may carry `manifest`: what the site's proven owner declares (same vocabulary), with `manifest_provenance: owner_declared`; it is never a verified fact.

agent_token.description: Optional. The read_token returned when your key registered. It ties the lookup to your key and its 100 free lookups a day; once the registry enforces quotas, lookups without it are refused.

client_class.description: Optional. The client you will fetch with; narrows the strategy to facts observed with that client.

host.description: Hostname to look up, for example example.com. No scheme or path; www. and case are normalised.

name: lookup_origin
title: Look up how a website treats agents
